name: Atlas Capital — PE Deal Room
description: A private equity fund evaluating the acquisition of Meridian Technologies, a fictitious fintech company. Analysts see public materials; VPs add deal memos and models; partners see IC and LP documents.

role_hints.analyst: public filings, research notes, press release, sector overview, public news
role_hints.vp: adds deal memos, financial models, diligence analyses, internal memos
role_hints.partner: full corpus including IC memo, LP update, and legal diligence

empty_state_description: Choose a scenario or enter a question. Query retrieves document fragments; the decision trace explains access, versions and budget. Ask generates an answer only when a provider is configured.
